name: drawio-agent-monorepo
description: Monorepo for DrawIO Agent - Self-hosted draw.io editor extended with AI chat sidebar

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared -w services/api -w frontend/sidebar
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc -b packages/shared/tsconfig.json services/api/tsconfig.json frontend/sidebar/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared -w services/api -w frontend/sidebar
